**Three facts that drove it:**
1. The single BUY of 23,620 (9.48x depth) sat 1 tick off the touch and was cancelled after 966 ms. The trader had no fills and made no opposite-side trade, so there was no benefit (feature b).
2. 400 ms after the cancel, the trader re-entered BUY 2,362 at the same price. That is exactly one tenth of the size, which fits an entry-size error that was corrected at once (fat finger). The trader's typical order size is 500.
3. There was no repetition, no prior alerts, no market event and no registered market-making role. No other explanation fits.

**What would change my mind:** a SELL execution by this trader around the placement, or other large one-sided orders from the same trader in the session.
